# ProjectCreateScope

`schemas/api/scope/project-create.json`

The scope of project.create (docs/design/m0/07; M1 slice plan P1): the project's first profile revision, a complete project profile whose id names the project. internal/profile's semantic checks run on it before anything is written. The revision, its digest, the creator and the time are the controller's, never the request's.

A document is one of: [project-profile](config-project-profile.md).
